title: Connect tutor verification to executable learning tools
summary: Close the verification-navigation gap found while auditing the twelve-mode tutor specification.

changes.detail: Code challenge verification now opens the executable studio instead of the code-reading practice page.
English, French and Arabic verification guidance with JavaScript, Python and math tool links; explains manual output comparison, factual source checks and limits without awarding mastery.
Requirements audit maps the twelve modes, teaching loop, persistence, structured UI and testing to implementation and explicit limitations.

validation.name: Pending verification
validation.detail: Interaction tests, full regression, typecheck, lint, export and multilingual browser checks pending. Live model quality, real cloud and native devices unverified.
